why: The outcome engine (the moat) needs ground truth: what happened to people with a given profile. Collect at baseline, then every 3 months, and after every sprint.
status: Original items. Single items are fine here because they are aggregated across thousands of users, not used to judge one person.

schedule.periodic: Every 3 months by email/push, about 2 minutes
schedule.per_sprint: Day 0, daily check-ins, and day-final (see sprint spec in the app master prompt)

current_work.text: What is your main activity right now?
Describe what you actually do most days.
current_work.coding: LLM-coded to the lane taxonomy and to an O*NET-SOC occupation code; user confirms.

current_work.text: How long have you been doing this?

fit_and_wellbeing.text: All in all, how satisfied are you with the work you do?
After a normal workday, how do you usually feel?
How often do you think another line of work would suit you much better?
fit_and_wellbeing.why: Directly measures the 'grass is greener' problem the product exists to solve.

fit_and_wellbeing.text: How sure are you that you are on the right path for you?
If nothing forced you to change, would you still be doing this in 3 years?

performance.text: Compared with others doing the same work, where would you place yourself?
In the last 3 months, have you had any objective signs of doing well (promotion, raise, award, ranking, revenue, audience growth)? Describe.
Compared with 3 months ago, your income from this work is...
